answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, as a result paying the comet bond on all of them and exposing each to the falcon slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 16 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the sable audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Collateral of 18 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
